COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.APPLICABILITY_CONDITION: the criterion carries a mechanical, single-valued, total-order comparator over its input survivors
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED: at least one input survivor lacks a mechanically derivable, single-valued, traceable comparator value
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.EVALUATED: there are at least two DISTINCT mechanically established comparator values among INPUT_SURVIVORS AND applying the comparator eliminates at least one survivor
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.TIED: all INPUT_SURVIVORS carry the SAME mechanically established comparator value AND zero survivors are eliminated
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.CONFLICT: the mechanically established inputs themselves contain a contradictory constraint that prevents a single valid comparator result
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.EXHAUSTIVENESS: every criterion evaluation resolves to exactly one of EVALUATED / TIED / NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED / CONFLICT
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.OUTPUT_SURVIVORS_ON_EVALUATED: only the survivors that share the winning value (all survivors carrying the best comparator value)
COMPARATOR_STATUS_PARTITION_CORRECTION.RELATION_TO_AMENDMENT_006_GLOBAL_ALGORIT: this partition refines and supersedes the ambiguous EVALUATED / TIED wording of the Amendment 006 global lexicographic algorithm; PRIORITY_METHOD = LEXICOGRAPHIC_ONLY, the strict criterion sequence P1..P7, the survivor mechanics, the required per-criterion output record and the fail-closed halt rules of Amendment 006 are unchanged
